name: Weather forecast
status: Connected · published to Atlas and verified on production
description: Four daily periods at representative interior points. Model grid output; not a measured district average. Model issue time is not supplied by this endpoint.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo · CC BY 4.0
authentication: Free non-commercial endpoint; commercial customer API key supported in ETL only
license: CC BY 4.0 data; API access terms apply separately
commercial_permission: Free endpoint excludes commercial use; customer subscription required
redistribution_permission: Attribution required; source data licence applies
spatial_resolution: Provider model grid; returned grid coordinate retained
latency: Model updates vary; issue time unavailable in response
fallback: Retain last complete published snapshot; disclose age and failed runs

name: Reservoirs & dams
status: Connected · 35 daily reports published to Atlas and verified on production
cadence: Daily report · 08:15 ICT; independent of weather
description: 35 large-dam daily storage reports. RID coordinates matched to canonical geography. Report date is supplied; exact observation time is unknown. Flow quantities remain outside the accepted product until their accumulation window is verified.
attribution: Royal Irrigation Department · Government Open Data / DGA Open Government License
authentication: Documented public GET succeeded without credentials; other products unverified
license: RID dataset catalogued as Open Data Common; DGA Open Government License terms and attribution retained
commercial_permission: DGA open-data terms permit reuse; project use is non-commercial
redistribution_permission: Attribution and original data meaning must be retained; provider exceptions apply
request_quota: Not published; one scheduled documented GET per day, with bounded failure retries
spatial_coverage: 35 verified large-dam IDs; coordinates published by the RID map
spatial_resolution: Dam location point; not reservoir extent or downstream influence
temporal_resolution: Daily report date only; no fabricated observation instant
units_crs: million m³; percent of normal storage capacity (may exceed 100%); RID published latitude/longitude
latency: Provider publication time is not specified; report date and retrieval time shown independently
fallback: Retain last complete 35-dam published generation; disclose age and failure

name: Agency CAP warnings
status: Connected · public CAP feed published to Atlas and verified on production
cadence: Hourly CAP snapshot; provider issuance and expiry are separate
description: Latest public Actual CAP messages, original agency severity, issue/effective/expiry times and source polygons. Expired, cancelled and superseded messages are not current warnings. Absence does not establish safe conditions or complete warning coverage.
attribution: Thai Meteorological Department (กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา); public CAP feed
authentication: Official public RSS/CAP channel; no key required. Registered forecast/radar products remain separate.
license: Feed declares public domain; TMD website copyright allows attributed non-commercial republication
commercial_permission: Not accepted for this implementation; user confirmed personal/non-commercial public use
redistribution_permission: Retain TMD attribution, original content and meaning, and source timestamps; no agency endorsement
request_quota: No numeric quota published in reviewed RSS documentation; one hourly index poll and bounded sequential document requests
spatial_coverage: Latest public CAP feed subset; no claim of complete national warning coverage
spatial_resolution: Original WGS84 CAP polygons and explicit ISO3166-2 province references; no inferred district warning
temporal_resolution: CAP sent/effective/expires instants; missing expiry stays unknown
units_crs: Agency severity/urgency/certainty retained; WGS84 CAP lat/lon converted to GeoJSON lon/lat
latency: Hourly ingestion plus repository scheduler/reader cache latency; not a live warning service
fallback: Retain last complete feed; failed, delayed or stale refresh pauses current thematic outlines

name: River & rain gauges
description: HII publishes attributed non-commercial monthly CSV archives and station metadata. The sampled September file is historical; the October directory was empty at review. A current API, timezone/quality semantics and live product acceptance remain pending. ThaiWater.Standard defines exchange formats, not nationwide API entitlement.
authentication: Public monthly archives need no key; current API access arrangement is not configured
license: Reviewed monthly archive catalog: Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial; live product terms unverified
commercial_permission: Monthly archive catalog is non-commercial; live product unverified
redistribution_permission: Monthly catalog requires attribution/non-commercial use; current API republication scope pending
units_crs: Archive catalog labels water level in meters above mean sea level; station datum/timezone and live product still require acceptance

name: Satellite flood observations
description: Official flood catalog directs users to register for an API key and leaves its dataset license unspecified. Product permission and an acquisition-time sample are required before enabling satellite-observed flood extents.
authentication: Registered user-owned gateway key required; not configured
license: Official flood catalog: License not specified; reuse permission pending
